entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
The All Blacks are not buying into talk France have brought out a second-rate side for this weekend's Nations Championship clash | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1

"I'm not buying into this rubbish that they're bringing over a B team or anything like that. They are one of the best teams in the world, they'll bring everything," said All Blacks assistant coach Neil Barnes.
 
First-five Damian McKenzie said there was too much class in the French ranks to underestimate them

Full story: https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/sport/643617/they-ll-bring-everything-all-blacks-don-t-consider-france-a-b-team
